run_ssd_eval: run LiveCodeBench v6 evaluation on an SSD-trained model checkpoint with vLLM generation and pass@k scoring
build_lcb_prompt: build a formatted prompt string from a question and optional starter code using the model's chat template
extract_code_from_completion: extract Python code from a model completion text by parsing the first fenced code block
load_lcb_v6_problems: load LiveCodeBench v6 problems from HuggingFace Hub and filter by date, difficulty, or count
compute_code_generation_metrics: compute pass@k metrics via sandboxed test execution on generated code solutions
